race.description: Sportsbet Get On Extra Mdn Plate
race.comment: The top two picks look like dominating this shallow maiden. NEVER PEGASUS (4) gets the nod after closing well to finish third over a similar trip to this at Murray Bridge on Wednesday. Has placed at three of his five runs and he won't get a better chance than this to break the ice. SHUJINKO (5) brings some decent Victorian form across and is the obvious danger. Very good two back when beaten just over a length over this trip at Coleraine. Nicely drawn and will be hard to hold out against this inferior opposition. HASTA LA OINKERS (2) resumes. Best form comes at or around 2000m so this seems too short, but while fresh he can surprise. ANTONETTE (7) didn't do a bad job on debut two back at Gawler then needed more ground last start when down the track at Penola. This looks a more suitable assignment.
